pilot.text: Read-only protocol check: inspect the repository top level, locate package.json, and make one appropriate inspection tool call. Do not modify files or execute any project code.

tasks.text: Read only: inspect package.json and report the package name, required Node.js version, and available npm scripts. Do not modify any file.
Without changing the repository, locate the CLI entry point and summarize which top-level commands it accepts. Cite filenames in the answer.
Perform a read-only inspection of the schema-bridge preset directory. Identify its manifest files and the two tools it assembles.
Inspect the test directory without edits. Find the tests that exercise a real DeepSeek Harness process and summarize their skip conditions.
Read the project README and the schema-bridge README, then state the documented distinction between mount diagnostics and live sampling. Leave the working tree untouched.
仅做只读检查：查看 .gitignore 与发布目录约定，说明哪些原始实验产物不得进入版本控制；不要修改任何文件。
在不改动仓库的前提下，阅读 src/strategies.mjs，列出四个 schema bridge 臂及各自的 description/parameters 因子。
只读检查 runtime/lab-runner.mjs，概括它为单次轨迹报告的 request、assistant、retry 和工具结果字段。
检查 experiments/schema-bridge-live/oracle.json 但不要编辑，说明它冻结的运行控制、样本设计和表面哈希类别。
阅读 schema bridge live scorer 源码，说明 D/Q/I 对比、Holm 校正与任务簇 bootstrap 的定义；保持工作树不变。
